purpose: Reconstruct Project-Frankenstein boot, restart, recovery and persistence evolution from exact accessible Git evidence. This is a bounded lineage artifact, not a claim of exhaustive repository history or current runtime equivalence.

scope.covered_window: 2026-02-15 through 2026-02-22 high-information lifecycle/persistence commits plus selected later persistence search signals
not_claimed: first creation date of every service
complete boot chronology before 2026-02-15 or after 2026-02-22
runtime reproduction of historical commit-message claims

timeline.mechanism: Router/watchdog coordination for memory-pressure model swapping moved from systemctl mask semantics to an explicit /tmp/frank_mpc_llama_parked coordination flag.
timeline.observed_diff_fact: The router writes/removes the park flag around Llama/Qwen swaps and the watchdog suppresses Llama restart while the flag exists.
timeline.historical_report: Commit message reports the full swap cycle verified: park, prevent watchdog restart, idle-out restore.
timeline.inference: Recovery agents need an explicit shared representation of intentional unavailability; process absence alone is ambiguous between failure and orchestration intent.
timeline.current_reuse_implication: Typed lifecycle intent/generation should accompany health/restart observation so HCU/EntityOS recovery does not fight planned transitions.
timeline.promotion_boundary: No current runtime or HCU credit.

timeline.mechanism: ASRS error counting was filtered to exclude systemd lifecycle messages generated by ASRS-driven restarts.
timeline.negative_result: ASRS counted its own restart/revalidation lifecycle errors as application failures, creating restart -> error log -> detect errors -> more restarts feedback.
timeline.observed_diff_fact: The error counter now skips systemd Failed to start, Stopped, Starting and Start request repeated lines.
timeline.inference: Recovery telemetry is causal input, not neutral logging; self-generated control-plane events must be typed or excluded before they re-enter anomaly triggers.
timeline.current_reuse_implication: EntityOS control/recovery observations should carry origin/cause identity and should not recursively mint fresh fault evidence from their own effects.

timeline.mechanism: Entity notifications were moved to SQLite persistence so they survive overlay restart while a centralized idle dispatcher replaced five fixed-time timers.
timeline.historical_report: Commit message states entity notifications persist across overlay restarts and dispatcher sessions interrupted by user_returned do not consume quota.
timeline.inference: Restart semantics affect both scheduling/accounting state and user-visible state; these should not be reconstructed from process memory alone.
timeline.promotion_boundary: Mechanism requires exact diff/runtime follow-up before stronger classification.

timeline.mechanism: All messages, including system messages, were persisted to SQLite for UI restoration while system messages remained excluded from the LLM conversation ring buffer.
timeline.observed_diff_fact: SQLite retrieval stopped filtering is_system rows; message storage persists all message classes and UI reload restores them while LLM context still excludes system-role entries.
timeline.inference: Durable user-visible state and model-context state are distinct projections and should not share an implicit persistence policy.
timeline.current_reuse_implication: Supports EntityOS separation of canonical durable state from rebuildable/model-facing projections; persistence does not imply cognitive-context admission.
timeline.promotion_boundary: Historical source mechanism only; no current UnifiedDB equivalence claim.

timeline.mechanism: Installer gained the frank-overlay.service definition and changed overlay start/restart from an ad-hoc launcher to systemd.
timeline.negative_result: Gaming mode, watchdog, writer mode and self-restart referenced an overlay service that the installer did not create.
timeline.observed_diff_fact: The service declares After/Wants on aicore-core and aicore-router, is enabled during install and becomes the documented restart path.
timeline.inference: A recovery path is not installable architecture unless the installer creates the lifecycle object it assumes.
timeline.current_reuse_implication: Installer/preflight classification must verify actual lifecycle mechanism existence, not infer it from consumers that reference a name.

timeline.mechanism: System restart evolved into dependency-ordered parallel waves: LLMs -> router -> core -> daemons -> overlay; restart result was persisted across overlay restart and singleton/dead-man race conditions were repaired.
timeline.historical_report: Commit message identifies five restart waves, singleton lock race repair, explicit lock release, persisted restart result and duplicate-overlay failsafe repair.
timeline.inference: Restart is a state transition graph with ordering, ownership and re-entry semantics, not a bag of independent service restarts.
timeline.current_reuse_implication: EntityOS/HCU restart/quiescence acceptance should bind generation, dependency order, survivor detection and result re-entry before claiming recovery completion.
timeline.promotion_boundary: Exact historical implementation partly observed; historical runtime behavior not independently reproduced here.

cross_cutting_patterns.statement: A stopped process can mean failure, intentional park, shutdown, dependency transition or user action; recovery needs typed intent before acting.
cross_cutting_patterns.falsifier: A recovery controller that uses process/health state only must reproduce all intentional transition cases without false restarts under controlled swaps.

cross_cutting_patterns.statement: Recovery actions can generate telemetry that re-triggers the same recovery loop unless causal origin is typed or filtered.
cross_cutting_patterns.falsifier: A controlled restart sequence whose own lifecycle logs are fed into the unfiltered detector must not increase restart triggering.

cross_cutting_patterns.statement: State that must survive process restart is not automatically state that should enter model context.
cross_cutting_patterns.falsifier: Show that one undifferentiated persistence/context channel retains restart continuity without contaminating model context across representative system events.

cross_cutting_patterns.statement: Boot/recovery consumers, installer-created services and declared dependency order must close over the same lifecycle graph.
cross_cutting_patterns.falsifier: A clean installation must demonstrate every recovery-referenced service exists and can traverse the declared dependency restart sequence.

open_gaps: Reconstruct the pre-2026-02-15 boot/service origin chronology from older commits.
Extract the exact five-wave restart implementation diff and service membership into a machine-readable dependency graph.
Trace later watchdog/health/recovery changes after 2026-02-22, including HTTP health checks and neural/runtime service expansion.
Separate /tmp coordination state, SQLite durable state, systemd unit state and in-memory state by persistence lifetime and authority.
Reproduce selected historical negative controls only if an admitted non-provider isolated execution surface and exact source identity make that useful.

adopt: typed lifecycle intent distinct from observed liveness
durable state distinct from model-facing projection
self-generated recovery telemetry excluded or causally typed
do_not_inherit_blindly: commit-message runtime reports as current executable credit
watchdog restart as proof of correct recovery

next_exact_action: Extend this artifact backward and forward in Git chronology, then derive a separate service/dependency/persistence-lifetime graph; do not mark A-10 complete until material boot/state families are exhaustively reconciled.
